blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Robin Padilla said on Wednesday he will appear before Department of Justice (DOJ) prosecutors, adding that he was “happy” to be subpoenaed to answer an obstruction of justice complaint filed against him. The Philippine National Police filed a complaint against Padilla for allegedly aiding the escape of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa in the early morning of May 14. Dela Rosa faces an International Criminal Court arrest warrant over alleged crimes against humanity in the drug war. “Naligayahan po ako… Hindi ako nalugmok, hindi ako nalungkot,” Padilla said, sharing how he reacted to the subpoena.
